name: EPIC 202811129
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 15.0 solar radii and 1.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 202811129 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.962084 (16th-84th percentiles 14.427367-15.901573), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 4,648 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 1.88 solar masses and 15.0 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,727 K at its surface.
